The unique decomposition u=(1+a)b with a in J_diff and b in 1+J_same yields a polynomial bijection with polynomial inverse: the fiber is affine dimension d(c). Diagonal ranks of triangular idempotents equal numbers of ones, so every joint finite-field rank coefficient is sum q^d(c). Independent FK subset expansion proves q^m Z_G(2^k,q^{-1}-1), with no characteristic restrictions. A chain clique lower bound and longest-chain-height coloring prove sharp saturation degree exactly when 2^k>=height(P). The actual bundled checker exhaustively constructed and independently tested every matrix and tuple in nine small (poset,q,k) settings, including GF4, against charts, joint ranks, and a separate FK evaluation; VERIFY_OK. originality.rationale: The finding is specifically the explicit color-indexed affine chart, all-field joint rank polynomial for ordered commuting idempotents, its Fortuin--Kasteleyn identification, and the exact height threshold for the leading degree. Prior theorems DO cover the standalone diagonalizability assertion (Gogić--Tomašević, arXiv:2409.16906 Theorem 3.4 and arXiv:2503.14116 Remark 3.8) and the one-idempotent component decomposition (Can--Casimiro--Malheiro, arXiv:2208.01073 Theorem 3.2). Those known results are credited; they neither print nor directly state the joint rank-weighted finite-field formula or its graph-polynomial identity. The latter requires identifying the unipotent centralizer quotient by all joint colors, a polynomial affine transversal, and the graph edge-weight evaluation. Full relevant sections of the closest primary papers were inspected. There remains an explicit bibliographic risk of previously known orbit-stabilizer consequences under other terminology. This is a provisional originality assessment, not a claim of exhaustive priority.

value.rationale: The precise invariant is natural: ordered pairwise commuting algebra idempotents correspond to representations of an k-fold product of two-element Boolean algebras into a finite-poset incidence algebra. The complete multivariate joint natural-matrix-rank polynomial was not supplied by single-idempotent orbit geometry or by simultaneous diagonalization alone, and encodes every possible joint rank with multiplicity for arbitrary finite posets and finite fields. Its total is precisely a graph statistical-mechanical partition-function evaluation, permitting recovery of the comparability-graph Tutte polynomial as k,q vary, with a sharp threshold tied to the actual poset height. It is an infinite-family structural and enumerative classification, not merely a known table or a small numerical increment. Significant limitations: it does not address non-idempotent commuting tuples, and the graph coloring threshold itself is elementary.
